div.div:
The lesson
Suppression answers only from the EVPN MAC+IP table. A silent host has no entry, so its first ARP is flooded whatever you configure. Suppression must be on at the leaf where the ARP arrives: on NX-OS that means a TCAM carve and a reload first.
